title: Evidence span
description: One located, source-layer-tagged span of text supporting a claim, event, or code. Full original text lives only in the private analysis zone; this record carries locators, a checksum, and (optionally) a short permitted excerpt, never the full passage, per research/source_policy.md.

evidence_id.description: Stable ID, e.g. ev.hist.01.42.base or ev.hist.01.42.ann.0 or ev.rom.049.7.

source_id.description: Identifies the crawled source document (work + volume/chapter).

edition_ref.description: Edition/printing identifier once more than one edition exists; null while only one edition is present (see data/normalization_plan.md).

annotation_index.description: Set only for HISTORY_ANNOTATION spans; a paragraph may embed more than one bracketed annotation run.

text_hash.description: sha256 of the exact extracted text, for reproducibility and duplicate detection.

permitted_excerpt.description: Optional short excerpt only, never the full paragraph, even though this corpus is owner-confirmed public domain (handoffs/DECISIONS.md#D-012) — repo commit policy in data/DATA_ZONES.md still excludes bulk crawled text.

extraction_reviewer.description: Human or role responsible for this extraction; 'unreviewed' if not yet checked by a person.

coding_validation_status.description: Added S3/E1 (D-017). Mandatory disclosure of whether this evidence's coding has been human-reviewed. Matches app/architecture/api_contract.yaml's EvidenceSpan field of the same name — do not let the two drift apart again.

ambiguity_note.description: Null means not applicable, never a stand-in for missing/low confidence.
